title.en: Burnham urged to ditch Mahmood’s migrant settlement plans to stop Labour being ‘imitation’ of Reform – UK politics live
title.zh: 伯纳姆被敦促放弃马哈茂德的移民安置计划，以防工党成为改革党的“模仿者”——英国政治直播

summary.en: The news reports a political debate in the UK, where Andy Burnham is being urged to abandon certain migrant settlement plans to distinguish the Labour party from the Reform party. The report also notes the death of former Conservative minister Ann Widdecombe at 78.
summary.zh: 新闻报道了英国的一场政治辩论，安迪·伯纳姆被敦促放弃某些移民安置计划，以使工党与改革党区分开来。报道还提及前保守党大臣安·威迪科姆去世，享年78岁。

body.en: Burnham set to be next PM with strong support from all wings of the party as 322 Labour MPs back him The former Conservative minister Ann Widdecombe has died aged 78, her management has said. Kevin Rawlinson has the story. Good morning. Even the BBC has (almost) given up describing Andy Burnham as the person who is likely, or almost certain, to become the next PM. As of last night, it is now, barring something so unexpected it would be in the act of God category, a done deal. Labour published the names of the MPs who have already nominated Burnham, and he has got 322 nominations. There are only 81 Labour MPs left who have not nominated anyone. By coincidence (or not?), 81 is exactly the number of names a rival candidate would need to stand. But in Labour politics the outgoing leader does not nominate a successor, and so in practice Burnham has already cleared the threshold. It’s wrapped up; he is the next leader and PM. Continue reading...
body.zh: 伯纳姆将在党内各派的大力支持下成为下一任首相，有 322 名工党议员支持他。前保守党部长安·维德科姆 (Ann Widdecombe) 的管理层表示，她已去世，享年 78 岁。凯文·罗林森有这个故事。早上好。甚至英国广播公司（BBC）也（几乎）放弃将安迪·伯纳姆描述为可能或几乎肯定成为下一任总理的人。从昨晚开始，现在已经是板上钉钉的事了，除非出现意外的情况，否则就属于天灾范畴。工党公布了已经提名伯纳姆的议员名单，伯纳姆获得了 322 项提名。目前只剩下 81 名工党议员尚未提名任何人。巧合（或不是？），81 正是竞争对手候选人需要参选的人数。但在工党政治中，即将卸任的领导人不会提名继任者，因此伯纳姆实际上已经扫清了门槛。它被包裹起来了；他是下一任领导人和总理。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Debates over migrant settlement plans often highlight the challenge of integrating newcomers into society. The ancient wisdom reminds us to treat foreigners residing among us as native-born, extending them the same dignity and rights. This principle calls for compassion and fairness in crafting policies that affect those seeking a new home.
reflection.zh: 关于移民安置计划的辩论常常凸显了将新来者融入社会的挑战。古老的智慧提醒我们，要将居住在我们中间的外国人视同本地人，给予他们同样的尊严和权利。这一原则呼吁我们在制定影响寻求新家园者的政策时，要秉持怜悯和公正。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Wildfires in southern Spain kill at least 11 amid soaring temperatures
title.zh: 西班牙南部野火在高温中造成至少11人死亡

summary.en: Wildfires in southern Spain, exacerbated by soaring temperatures, have resulted in at least 11 deaths, with 23 people still unaccounted for. Four Britons are believed to be among those who died while attempting to escape the fast-moving blaze in the Almería region.
summary.zh: 西班牙南部野火在高温下蔓延，已造成至少11人死亡，另有23人失踪。据信，有四名英国人在阿尔梅里亚地区试图逃离迅速蔓延的大火时丧生。

body.en: At least four Britons believed to be among those who died attempting to flee blaze in heatwave-struck Almería region At least 11 people have been killed and 23 are unaccounted for after a fast-moving wildfire broke out in south-east Spain as the country endures its second heatwave of the summer. The regional government of Andalucía said the victims, four of whom are believed to be British, had died while trying to flee the flames near the village of Bédar in the Los Gallardos municipality of Almería. Continue reading...
body.zh: 据信，至少有四名英国人在遭受热浪袭击的阿尔梅里亚地区试图逃离大火时丧生。西班牙东南部正在经历夏季第二次热浪，该国东南部爆发了一场快速蔓延的野火，造成至少 11 人死亡，23 人下落不明。安达卢西亚地方政府表示，遇难者中有四人据信是英国人，他们在阿尔梅里亚洛斯加拉多斯市贝达尔村附近试图逃离大火时死亡。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the Spanish wildfires reminds us of the fragility of life and the deep sorrow that natural disasters can bring. In moments of such profound grief, we hold onto the promise that Yahweh will one day wipe away every tear, and death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. This hope offers solace to those who mourn and a vision of...
reflection.zh: 西班牙野火中生命的悲剧性逝去，提醒我们生命的脆弱以及自然灾害带来的深切悲痛。在如此深重的悲伤时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去所有眼泪的应许，那时死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛都将不再有。这份盼望为哀伤者带来慰藉，并描绘了一个被更新的世界的异象。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Ann Widdecombe, former Tory MP and Reform UK member, dies aged 78
title.zh: 前保守党议员、英国改革党成员安·威德科姆去世，享年78岁

summary.en: Ann Widdecombe, a former Conservative MP and prominent Eurosceptic, has died at the age of 78. She was a social conservative who served as an MP and MEP, and was described as a 'force of nature' by Reform leader Nigel Farage.
summary.zh: 前保守党议员、英国改革党成员安·威德科姆去世，享年78岁。这位著名的疑欧派和社会保守主义者曾担任议员和欧洲议会议员，英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇称她为“一股自然力量”。

body.en: Prominent Eurosceptic and social conservative paid tribute to as ‘force of nature’ by Reform leader Nigel Farage The former Conservative minister Ann Widdecombe has died aged 78, her management has said. Widdecombe, who served as an MP and an MEP during a lengthy and often controversial political career, gained notoriety as a television personality in later life. Besides the Tories, she was also a member of the Brexit party and its successor, Reform UK. Continue reading...
body.zh: 改革领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇 (Nigel Farage) 著名的欧洲怀疑论者和社会保守派人士赞扬了“自然的力量”。 前保守党部长安·维德科姆 (Ann Widdecombe) 的管理层表示，她已去世，享年 78 岁。维德科姆在漫长且经常引起争议的政治生涯中担任过国会议员和欧洲议会议员，在晚年作为电视名人而声名狼藉。 Besides the Tories, she was also a member of the Brexit party and its successor, Reform UK.继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news of a long and impactful life concluding invites us to reflect on the race we are all called to run. For those who serve in public life, the end of their earthly journey marks the completion of their unique contribution. May we all strive to finish our course with integrity and purpose, trusting Yahweh with the outcome.
reflection.zh: 一段漫长而有影响力的生命走到尽头，这促使我们反思每个人被呼召去奔跑的赛程。对于那些在公共生活中服务的人来说，他们尘世旅程的结束标志着他们独特贡献的完成。愿我们都努力以正直和目标完成我们的道路，将结果交托给雅伟。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: Police officer hurt amid violent disorder in London after France beat Morocco
title.zh: 法国击败摩洛哥后伦敦发生暴力骚乱，一名警官受伤

summary.en: Police reported violent disorder in London following France's World Cup victory over Morocco, leading to four arrests and a police officer being injured. Separately, a teenager died in France during celebrations.
summary.zh: 警方报告称，法国在世界杯上击败摩洛哥后，伦敦发生了暴力骚乱，导致四人被捕，一名警官受伤。此外，一名青少年在法国的庆祝活动中死亡。

body.en: Four arrests after Edgware Road incidents, say police Teenager dies in France while celebrating team’s win A police officer has been hurt and several people were arrested after disorder in London on Thursday night in the wake of France beating Morocco 2-0 in a World Cup quarter-final in Boston in the United States. Police and fans clashed on Edgware Road. Footage on social media appears to show flares being set off and missiles being thrown at officers in the middle of a London street. The Metropolitan police said four people were arrested for violent disorder and one officer had been taken to hospital with a head injury after being hit by a glass bottle. Continue reading...
body.zh: 埃奇韦尔路事件后四人被捕，警察称法国青少年在庆祝球队获胜时死亡周四晚上，法国队在美国波士顿举行的世界杯四分之一决赛中以 2-0 击败摩洛哥队后，伦敦发生骚乱，一名警察受伤，数人被捕。警察和球迷在埃奇韦尔路发生冲突。社交媒体上的视频似乎显示，有人在伦敦街道中央引爆照明弹，并向警察投掷导弹。伦敦警察厅表示，四人因暴力骚乱被捕，一名警官被玻璃瓶击中头部受伤，被送往医院。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Intense emotions, even from sports, can sometimes spill over into destructive behavior, causing harm to others and leading to tragic outcomes. This incident reminds us that choosing violence, regardless of the provocation, often brings its own painful consequences. Yahweh calls us to a path of peace, recognizing that resorting to force ultimately harms all...
reflection.zh: 即使是源于体育赛事的强烈情绪，有时也可能演变为破坏性行为，对他者造成伤害并导致悲剧性后果。这起事件提醒我们，无论起因如何，选择暴力往往会带来自身的痛苦后果。雅伟呼召我们走和平之路，认识到诉诸武力最终会伤害所有相关方。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: We've saved £6,000 on holidays by swapping homes with strangers
title.zh: 我们通过与陌生人交换房屋节省了6,000英镑的度假费用

summary.en: The BBC reports on the increasing popularity of home swapping as a method for people to significantly reduce their holiday expenses.
summary.zh: 英国广播公司报道了人们通过交换房屋来大幅削减度假成本的日益增长的趋势。

body.en:
Would you swap homes with a stranger in exchange for a cheaper holiday? Or would the idea of someone sleeping in your bed and using your kitchen while you were away put you off?

Henry Vanderpump, 42, his wife Elliw, 39, and their two young children have had two home exchange holidays in the past two years and have another planned this summer.

In each case, they have stayed in another family's home, while that family stays in theirs, a five-bedroom house in Tarporley, rural Cheshire.

Neither side pays anything for their accommodation, although they do pay an annual membership fee to Home Link, the listings site they use to book the trips.

So far, the Vanderpumps have stayed in similarly sized properties in Hamburg and Copenhagen, and Henry says they have saved around £2,500 on accommodation per trip, plus a further £700 on transport, as they also swapped cars.

"We used to have one holiday a summer, now we have two [because of the savings we make from home exchanges]. And the kids love the idea of living in someone else's house while that person is living in theirs."

Home exchanges have been around since at least the 1950s, but an increasing number of people seem to be embracing them because of the rising cost of living, or simply to experience a new type of travel, commentators say.

Henry says the best thing about swapping homes isn't the savings but getting to visit places off the tourist trail and have a "really authentic experience".

When the family visited Hamburg in 2024, they stayed in a suburb and lived "like a German family" for a week, exploring lakes on the edge of the city recommended by their hosts.

Last year, they stayed in "a very Scandinavian house" in suburban Copenhagen, which was "all on one level and had no clutter".

"They also left us several electric bikes to use," Henry says. "We cycled to the beach, swam in the Baltic and tried restaurants they recommended."

Some people are not comfortable with the idea of strangers staying in their home, and for those who are, there's a lot of preparation and tidying to do before their guests arrive.

Home swappers may also have to be more flexible about when they travel - Home Link says members typically send 10-15 messages before getting an offer.

"Last minute bookings won't always work," says May Burrough, 38, a chief operating officer from London who has done 34 home swaps over the last three years using HomeExchange.

Rather than doing direct exchanges, she hosts people in her central London flat while she's overseas staying with her partner in France.

This way, May builds up points on the platform she can use to book trips at other times.

May reckons she has saved about £5,000-£8,000 through swaps in places like Barcelona and the Swiss Alps.

She loves the "community feel"...
body.zh: 您会与陌生人交换房屋以换取更便宜的假期吗？或者当你不在的时候有人睡在你的床上并使用你的厨房的想法会让你感到厌烦吗？ 42 岁的亨利·范德庞普 (Henry Vanderpump)、他 39 岁的妻子埃利夫 (Elliw) 以及他们的两个年幼的孩子在过去两年中度过了两次房屋交换假期，并计划在今年夏天再度过一次。 在每种情况下，他们都住在另一个家庭的家里，而那个家庭则住在他们自己的房子里，那是位于柴郡乡村塔珀利的一栋五居室的房子。 双方都不需要支付任何住宿费用，尽管他们确实向 Home Link（他们用来预订旅行的列表网站）支付了年度会员费。 到目前为止，范德庞夫妇在汉堡和哥本哈根都住在类似规模的房产中，亨利说，他们每次旅行节省了约 2,500 英镑的住宿费用，另外还节省了 700 英镑的交通费用，因为他们还交换了汽车。 “我们过去每年夏天只有一个假期，现在我们有两个假期（因为我们通过房屋交换节省了开支）。孩子们喜欢住在别人的房子里，而那个人却住在他们的房子里。” 房屋交换至少从 20 世纪 50 年代就已经存在，但评论员表示，由于生活成本不断上涨，或者只是为了体验一种新型旅行，越来越多的人似乎开始接受房屋交换。 亨利说，交换房屋的最大好处不是省钱，而是参观旅游路线以外的地方并获得“真正真实的体验”。 当这家人在 2024 年访问汉堡时，他们在郊区“像德国家庭一样”生活了一周，探索主人推荐的城市边缘的湖泊。 去年，他们住在哥本哈根郊区的“一栋非常斯堪的纳维亚风格的房子”，“全部位于一个楼层，没有杂乱”。 “他们还给我们留下了几辆电动自行车供我们使用，”亨利说。 “我们骑自行车去海滩，在波罗的海游泳，并尝试了他们推荐的餐馆。” 有些人对陌生人住在自己家里感到不舒服，而对于那些感到不舒服的人来说，在客人到来之前需要做很多准备和整理工作。 房屋交换者在旅行时可能还必须更加灵活——Home Link 表示，会员通常会在收到报价之前发送 10 到 15 条消息。 “最后一刻的预订并不总是有效，”来自伦敦的 38 岁首席运营官 May Burrough 说，她在过去三年中使用 HomeExchange 进行了 34 次房屋互换。 当她与法国的伴侣一起在海外居住时，她并没有进行直接交流，而是在伦敦市中心的公寓里招待人们。 这样，梅就可以在平台上累积积分，以便在其他时间预订旅行。 梅估计，通过巴塞罗那和瑞士阿尔卑斯山等地的交换，她节省了大约 5,000 至 8,000 英镑。 她喜欢“社区感觉”......

reflection.en: This trend of home swapping highlights how shared resources can create rich experiences without great expense. It reminds us that true joy in life often comes from connection and resourcefulness, rather than lavish spending. Yahweh's wisdom suggests that simple living, marked by generosity and trust, can be more fulfilling than costly pursuits.
reflection.zh: 这种房屋互换的趋势表明，共享资源如何在不花费巨资的情况下创造丰富的体验。它提醒我们，生活中真正的喜乐往往来自人际连结和足智多谋，而非奢华的消费。雅伟的智慧启示我们，以慷慨和信任为标志的简朴生活，可能比昂贵的追求更令人满足。

verse.textEn: Better a small serving of vegetables with love than a fattened calf with hatred.
verse.textZh: 吃素菜，彼此相爱，强如吃肥牛，彼此相恨。

title.en: Swift nest reportedly thrown in skip during house renovations in South Tyneside
title.zh: 南泰恩赛德房屋翻修期间，雨燕巢穴据报被扔进垃圾箱

summary.en: Conservationists in South Tyneside are concerned that swift nests, potentially containing chicks, were destroyed and discarded during house renovations by a council-appointed contractor. This incident reportedly occurred despite existing regulations designed to protect such nests.
summary.zh: 南泰恩赛德的环保人士担心，在议会指定承包商进行房屋翻修期间，雨燕巢穴（可能含有雏鸟）被毁并丢弃。据报道，尽管有旨在保护此类巢穴的现有规定，但仍发生了这一事件。

body.en: Conservationists fear more nests may have been destroyed during work on Jarrow houses by council-appointed contractor Swift chicks are feared to have been thrown into a skip during house renovations in South Tyneside, despite rules that should stop the destruction of nests. The Northern Swifts Group (NSG) was alerted to the destruction of at least one nest on Tuesday, in a street in Jarrow where houses were being renovated by South Tyneside council. Continue reading...
body.zh: 环保人士担心，在南泰恩赛德的房屋翻修过程中，政府指定的承包商在贾罗房屋的施工过程中可能会毁坏更多的雨燕雏鸟，尽管有规定应该阻止破坏巢穴的行为，但人们担心雨燕雏鸟在南泰恩赛德的房屋翻修过程中被扔进料斗里。周二，北雨燕组织 (NSG) 接到警报称，南泰恩赛德议会正在贾罗的一条街道上翻修房屋，至少有一个鸟巢被毁。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The reported destruction of swift nests during renovations reminds us of our foundational call to care for creation. Yahweh placed humanity in the world not to exploit it carelessly, but to tend and protect it. This incident highlights the ongoing need for diligence and respect for all life, even amidst human development.
reflection.zh: 翻修工程中雨燕巢穴被毁的报道，提醒我们对受造物负有根本的看护责任。雅伟将人类安置在世上，并非任由我们随意开发，而是要我们耕耘和看守。这起事件凸显了在人类发展过程中，持续对所有生命保持谨慎和尊重的必要性。

verse.textEn: Yahweh God took the man and put him in the Garden of Eden to work it and take care of it.
verse.textZh: 雅伟神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理看守。

title.en: If the US-Iran war reignites, how badly could Australia be impacted?
title.zh: 如果美伊战争再次爆发，澳大利亚将受到多大影响？

summary.en: The news explores the potential consequences for Australia if the ceasefire between the United States and Iran breaks down, leading to a renewed intensification of fighting.
summary.zh: 这则新闻探讨了如果美国和伊朗之间的停火协议破裂，战火再次升级，可能对澳大利亚造成的影响。

body.en:
A recent escalation in fighting between the United States and Iran has once again raised the spectre of widespread economic pain.

Since late February, disruptions to shipping routes have led oil prices to skyrocket, triggering fears that a prolonged conflict could plunge much of the world into recession.

However, since an interim ceasefire was formalised with a memorandum of understanding in June, international oil prices have fallen back to pre-war levels.

For a time, it seemed as if economic fallout from the conflict could be more limited than initially feared.

Commonwealth Bank head of Australian economics Belinda Allen wrote in a 6 July research note that the impact of the war in Iran was "less severe than we originally expected".

Several days later, the bank's head of geoeconomics, Joe Capurso, said he too had expected oil prices to stay elevated for longer, but "they've come back down to pre-war levels very fast".

However, renewed fighting and statements made by political leaders in recent days have cast doubt on whether the ceasefire and easing of oil prices will hold.

On Wednesday, the US military launched fresh strikes on Iran, saying it was responding to Iranian attacks on commercial ships in the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz.

Declaring the ceasefire "over", US President Donald Trump said he would allow negotiations to continue , but added: "As far as I'm concerned, it's just a waste of time dealing with them".

Following that, Iran accused the US of violating the ceasefire deal and launched strikes on US military targets in the Gulf.

Jessica Genauer, an international conflict expert at the University of New South Wales, said the tit-for-tat strikes suggest the MoU the countries signed on 17 June would not lead to a permanent peace.

"I think what we're going to be looking at is a sort of a middle path," she told SBS News.

"I don't think that we're going to return to the full-scale war that we saw from the 28th of February until the 8th of April, but I also don't think that we're now on a path towards a really substantial peace that involves a more significant agreement between Iran and the US."

She said optimism in the markets following the agreement was "probably a little premature".

"I think that in Australia we're relatively resilient and robust, but we will start to see some costs and consequences from the fact that this war is not over."

She said that, given the current impasse between the two sides, the cycle of back-and-forth strikes is likely to continue.

title.en: China lands reusable rocket for first time, state media says
title.zh: 官媒称中国首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭

summary.en: China has successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time, according to state media, following similar achievements by US-owned companies SpaceX and Blue Origin.
summary.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国首次成功着陆了可重复使用的火箭，此前美国公司SpaceX和蓝色起源也实现了类似成就。

body.en:
China has successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in a major breakthrough for the country's space programme, according to state media.

The China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation said the Long March 10B rocket lifted off from Hainan in southern China at 12:15 local time (04:15GMT) on Friday.

Around six minutes after separating from the rocket's upper stage, its booster returned to Earth vertically and was recovered on a floating platform.

It signals that China may be able to challenge America's dominance in reusable rockets after successful landings by Elon Musk's SpaceX and Blue Origin, which is owned by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

Rockets are typically considered expendable - their various segments being discarded and destroyed during ascent - which makes launching spacecraft expensive.

By reusing boosters - which are generally seen as the most valuable part of a rocket - the cost of satellite launches and space exploration can be significantly lowered.

In December 2015, SpaceX landed a reusable Falcon 9 rocket from an orbital flight for the first time, followed by Blue Origin's New Glenn in November 2025.

The Falcon 9 now launches about 150 times a year with boosters that are capable of being reused dozens of times.

China made its first attempt at reusable rocket recovery in February, with a Long March 10A rocket. It completed a controlled descent and splashed down next to a recovery platform.

The Long March 10B, which can carry a payload of at least 16 metric tons to low-Earth orbit, has been compared to SpaceX's Falcon 9.

But unlike the Falcon 9, the Long March 10B does not autonomously land on a ground pad or drone ship. Instead "landing hooks" on the rocket catch a net attached to a floating platform.

Shares in Chinese space firms jumped following the news, with China Spacesat and China Satellite Communications each rising by 10%, the daily limit allowed by the country's financial market regulations.
body.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，这是中国太空计划的重大突破。 中国航天科技集团公司表示，长征十号乙运载火箭于当地时间周五中午 12 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 04 点 15 分）从中国南部的海南岛升空。 与火箭上级分离后大约六分钟，其助推器垂直返回地球，并在浮动平台上回收。 这标志着，在埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)的SpaceX和亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)旗下的蓝色起源(Blue Origin)成功着陆后，中国可能能够挑战美国在可重复使用火箭方面的主导地位。 火箭通常被认为是消耗性的——它们的各个部分在上升过程中被丢弃和毁坏——这使得发射航天器变得昂贵。 通过重复使用助推器（通常被视为火箭最有价值的部分），可以显着降低卫星发射和太空探索的成本。 2015 年 12 月，SpaceX 首次将可重复使用的猎鹰 9 号火箭从轨道飞行中着陆，随后蓝色起源的新格伦火箭于 2025 年 11 月着陆。 目前，猎鹰 9 号火箭每年发射约 150 次，其助推器可重复使用数十次。 今年二月，中国首次尝试使用长征十号甲运载火箭进行可重复使用火箭回收。它完成了受控下降并溅落在回收平台旁边。 长征十号B可以将至少16吨的有效载荷运送到近地轨道，有人将其与SpaceX的猎鹰9号进行比较。 但与猎鹰 9 号不同的是，长征十号 B 不能自动降落在地面垫或无人机船上。相反，火箭上的“着陆钩”抓住了连接在浮动平台上的网。 消息传出后，中国航天公司的股价大幅上涨，中国航天和中国卫星通信股价均上涨 10%，这是中国金融市场法规允许的涨停板。

reflection.en: This achievement in reusable rocket technology highlights humanity's relentless drive to innovate and expand our understanding of the world. It echoes the ancient prophecy that knowledge shall increase, reflecting the accelerating pace of human discovery and capability in our time.
reflection.zh: 这项可重复使用火箭技术成就，彰显了人类不断创新和拓展对世界认知的决心。它呼应了古老的预言，即知识将不断增长，反映了我们时代人类发现和能力加速发展的步伐。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Chip giant SK Hynix raises $26.5bn in mega US share sale
title.zh: 芯片巨头SK海力士在美国股市巨额募资265亿美元

summary.en: SK Hynix, a major chip manufacturer, has successfully raised $26.5 billion in a massive share sale in the US, marking the largest ever debut by a foreign firm on the Nasdaq.
summary.zh: 芯片巨头SK海力士在美国股市成功募资265亿美元，这是外国公司在纳斯达克有史以来规模最大的一次首次亮相。

body.en:
South Korean computer chip maker SK Hynix has raised $26.5bn (£19.8bn) in its New York share offering, marking the largest ever listing by a foreign firm in the US.

The company, a key supplier to artificial intelligence (AI) chip giant Nvidia, said on Thursday that it had sold 177.9 million American depositary shares for $149 each. The shares are set to begin trading on Friday on the Nasdaq.

SK Hynix saw its market value top $1tn in its home country in May, lifted by the boom in demand for AI chips.

Its share price has more than tripled in South Korea this year, which along with Samsung Electronics has helped boost the benchmark Kospi index by more than 70% over the same period.

SK Hynix is one of the world's leading memory chip makers. The industry has been given a major boost by the hundreds of billions being spent on AI.

Shares in rivals Samsung Electronics and Micron have more than doubled in recent months.

The US listing gives SK Hynix easier access to huge amounts of potential investment from the world's biggest economy, which has fewer barriers than South Korea, said Seoul National University finance professor Jaewon Choi.

Traders are closely watching the listing as a "yardstick to test the water" for whether investor enthusiasm for memory chip makers will continue, Choi said.

The AI boom has triggered a rush of companies raising money on the the stock market.

In June, GrokAI owner SpaceX became the world's biggest ever listing as it raised $85.7bn.

Meanwhile, AI developers Anthropic and OpenAI are preparing to go public, with valuations of more $1tn.

Demand for SK Hynix's offering was reportedly over seven times more than the number of shares available, highlighting the strong investor appetite for a key company in the AI supply chain.

Each American depositary share is equivalent to a tenth of a Seoul-traded common share, SK Hynix said.

The offering gives US investors a way to buy SK Hynix shares without having to trade via an overseas stock exchange.

The company has pledged major investments to develop South Korea's chip making and AI capabilities in the coming years.

The country's government is likely to be counting on SK Hynix's US listing to raise funds that can support the firm's domestic investments, said Hanyang University business professor Yun Youngjin.

But the Nasdaq listing carries some risks, especially if investors move money towards the US and away from South Korea's stock market, Yun added.

In June, the country's government unveiled plans for more than $880bn of investments in partnership with SK Hynix and Samsung.

Both SK Hynix and Samsung have stock market valuations of more that $1tn, joining growing group of firms which includes tech giants Nvidia, Apple, Microsoft and Google-owner Alphabet.
body.zh: 韩国计算机芯片制造商 SK 海力士在纽约股票发行中筹集了 265 亿美元（198 亿英镑），这是外国公司在美国上市以来规模最大的一次。 该公司是人工智能（AI）芯片巨头英伟达（Nvidia）的主要供应商，该公司周四表示，已以每股 149 美元的价格出售了 1.779 亿股美国存托股票。该股票定于周五在纳斯达克开始交易。 受人工智能芯片需求旺盛的推动，SK 海力士 5 月份在本国的市值突破 1 万亿美元。 今年，该公司股价在韩国上涨了两倍多，与三星电子一起帮助基准 Kospi 指数同期上涨了 70% 以上。 SK 海力士是全球领先的存储芯片制造商之一。数千亿美元的人工智能投入极大地推动了该行业的发展。 近几个月来，竞争对手三星电子和美光科技的股价上涨了一倍多。 首尔国立大学金融学教授 Jaewon Choi 表示，在美国上市使 SK 海力士更容易获得来自世界最大经济体的巨额潜在投资，而韩国的障碍比韩国少。 Choi 表示，交易员正在密切关注此次上市，将其视为投资者对存储芯片制造商的热情是否会持续的“试水标准”。 人工智能的繁荣引发了众多公司在股市上筹集资金的热潮。 6 月，GrokAI 母公司 SpaceX 筹集了 857 亿美元资金，成为全球有史以来规模最大的上市公司。 与此同时，人工智能开发商 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 正准备上市，估值超过 1 万亿美元。 据报道，对 SK 海力士发行股票的需求是现有股票数量的七倍多，这突显了投资者对人工智能供应链中一家关键公司的强烈兴趣。 SK 海力士表示，每股美国存托股票相当于首尔交易的普通股的十分之一。 此次发行为美国投资者提供了一种购买 SK 海力士股票的方式，而无需通过海外证券交易所进行交易。 该公司已承诺在未来几年进行重大投资，发展韩国的芯片制造和人工智能能力。 汉阳大学商学教授尹永进表示，韩国政府可能指望 SK 海力士在美国上市来筹集资金，支持该公司的国内投资。 但尹补充说，纳斯达克上市存在一些风险，特别是如果投资者将资金从韩国股市转移到美国的话。 6 月，该国政府公布了与 SK 海力士和三星合作投资超过 8800 亿美元的计划。 SK 海力士和三星的股票市场估值均超过 1 万亿美元，加入了包括科技巨头英伟达、苹果、微软和谷歌母公司 Alphabet 在内的不断壮大的公司行列。

reflection.en: This historic share sale highlights the immense capacity for wealth creation in our world. It reminds us to consider the ultimate source of all ability and prosperity, acknowledging that Yahweh empowers us to produce wealth. Such moments invite reflection on gratitude and stewardship, recognizing that all success ultimately flows from divine provision.
reflection.zh: 这次历史性的股票发售凸显了我们世界巨大的财富创造能力。它提醒我们思考所有能力和繁荣的最终来源，承认是雅伟赐予我们创造财富的能力。这样的时刻促使我们反思感恩和管家职分，认识到所有的成功最终都源于神的供应。

verse.textEn: Remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.
verse.textZh: 你要记念雅伟你的神，因为得货财的力量是他给你的。

title.en: Factory fire kills at least 28 in China's 'shoe capital'
title.zh: 中国“鞋都”工厂火灾造成至少28人死亡

summary.en: Footage shows huge flames rising from a building and thick, black smoke rising into the sky.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A fire at a shoe factory in the south-eastern Chinese city of Jinjiang has killed at least 28 people, according to the state news agency.

Dramatic footage posted by Xinhua showed huge plumes of black smoke rising from a building as well as people who appeared to be trapped on the roof.

President Xi Jinping said the blaze had caused "major casualties", adding those responsible must be held "strictly accountable".

Jinjiang, in the province of Fujian, is often referred to as China's "shoe capital" as it reportedly manufactures 20% of the world's sports shoes.

The blaze erupted at the Huiteng Footwear factory at around noon local time (05:00 BST) on Thursday.

Authorities dispatched more than 500 personnel to extinguish the blaze and rescue people, state media reported.

State media also reported that there were nearly 240 people at the factory when the fire broke out.

Among the 213 people who were evacuated, two of them later died in hospital. Twenty-six others, who had been initially missing, were found dead.

Initial reports suggest the fire may have started on the factory's ground floor where flammable materials were stored.

Authorities have detained a number of people who work for the factory's owners, and the firm's bank account was frozen, according to state media.

China started a campaign to prevent fires in high-rise buildings after a blaze ripped through several Hong Kong apartment buildings in November , killing 168 people.

Xi said Chinese officials must draw "profound lessons" from "several major industrial safety accidents" in the country this year.
body.zh: 据国家通讯社报道，中国东南部城市晋江一家鞋厂发生火灾，已造成至少 28 人死亡。 新华社发布的戏剧性画面显示，一座建筑物冒出巨大的黑烟，人们似乎被困在屋顶上。 习近平主席表示，火灾造成“重大人员伤亡”，并补充说必须“严肃追究责任者”。 福建省晋江经常被称为中国的“鞋都”，因为据报道，该市生产了全球 20% 的运动鞋。 当地时间周四中午（英国夏令时 05:00）左右，辉腾鞋业工厂发生火灾。 据官方媒体报道，当局出动了 500 多名人员扑灭大火并营救人员。 官方媒体还报道称，火灾发生时工厂内有近240人。 被疏散的213人中，有两人后来在医院死亡。最初失踪的另外 26 人被发现死亡。 初步报告显示，火灾可能是从工厂存放易燃材料的底层开始的。 据官方媒体报道，当局拘留了一些为该工厂老板工作的人员，该公司的银行账户也被冻结。 11 月，香港几栋公寓楼发生火灾，造成 168 人死亡，之后中国启动了高层建筑防火行动。 习近平表示，中国官员必须从今年发生的“几起重大工业安全事故”中吸取“深刻教训”。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Huge crowds in Mashhad as Iran's late supreme leader is buried
title.zh: 伊朗已故最高领袖下葬，马什哈德人潮涌动

summary.en: Ali Khamenei, Iran's late supreme leader, was buried at the Imam Reza shrine, a significant Shia Muslim site, concluding six days of public mourning.
summary.zh: 伊朗已故最高领袖阿里·哈梅内伊在什叶派穆斯林最神圣的伊玛目礼萨圣陵下葬，为期六天的公开哀悼仪式随之结束。

body.en:
Huge crowds lined the streets of the holy city of Mashhad for the burial of Iran's late supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.

Khamenei was laid to rest at the shrine of Imam Reza, Iran's holiest Shia Muslim site, marking the end of six days of public mourning ceremonies in five cities across Iran and neighbouring Iraq.

The burial, reported by the state news agency IRNA, came after an exchange of strikes between Iran and the US that threatens to derail a preliminary deal to end the war in which he was killed.

Earlier, Iran's Revolutionary Guards accused the US of bombing two bridges on the railway line from the capital, Tehran, to Mashhad overnight "in an effort to overshadow" the funeral.

Khamenei and several members of his family were killed in an Israeli strike on his residence in Tehran on 28 February, the first day of Iran's war with the US and Israel.

He was succeeded as supreme leader by his son Mojtaba, who has not been seen in public since he was reportedly seriously wounded in the same attack.

The 56-year-old did not participate in the funeral ceremonies in Tehran and Qom, and there was no indication that he attended the burial.

On Thursday morning, a plane carrying the coffins of Ali Khamenei, his granddaughter, son-in-law, daughter and Mojtaba's wife landed in Mashhad after flying from Iraq, where huge crowds took part in processions to two Shia shrines in the cities of Najaf and Karbala.

In the afternoon, Iranian TV footage showed thousands of mourners dressed in black walking along a main boulevard in central Mashhad. Many were waving Iranian flags and red banners symbolising vengeance.

Some people were also holding photos of the late supreme leader and placards calling for the death of US President Donald Trump, who, along with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, ordered the joint attack on Iran four months ago that triggered the war.

Hanging above the boulevard were banners with official slogans including "We must rise".

"The loss of the leader is heavier than losing our parents," Hoda, a 35-year-old housewife, told AFP news agency. "Only the death of Trump and Netanyahu will soothe our pain."

Later, a lorry transported Khamenei's coffin slowly through the crowds towards the Imam Reza shrine, eventually reaching the complex as night fell.

Imam Reza was the eighth Shia imam and the only one of the 12 believed to have been buried in Iran. His mausoleum, which dates to the 9th Century and has a towering golden dome and minarets, is visited by millions of pilgrims each year.

Khamenei was born in Mashhad, Iran's second-largest city located in the north-east of the country, and studied at seminaries in the city before moving to Qom, the centre of Iran's Shia clerical establishment.

title.en: Body of slain Iranian supreme leader arrives at Shia shrine as crowds chant 'Kill Trump'
title.zh: 遇害伊朗最高领袖遗体抵达什叶派圣地，人群高呼“杀死特朗普”

summary.en: Following the death of a prominent Iranian leader, large crowds gathered at a Shia shrine, chanting calls for revenge against the US. This event raises concerns about potential renewed attacks between the US and Iran, which could further destabilize global shipping and the economy.

body.en:
The funeral procession of Iran's slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has reached the country's holiest shrine for his burial as the crowd bore banners reading "We Will Kill Trump".

As a week of funeral events reached its culmination, Khamenei's son and successor, Mojtaba Khamenei, has not been seen in public view after the 28 February US-Israeli strike that killed his father, which started the current conflict in the Middle East.

Khamenei's body was carried by truck slowly through the crammed streets of Mashhad in northeastern Iran towards the gilt dome and minarets of the Shrine of Imam Reza, flanked by white-turbaned clerics. Black-clad mourners pressed in close behind, waving Iranian flags, photographs of the late Khamenei and red placards with revolutionary slogans.

A helicopter lifted his coffin the final short stretch with the truck unable to pass through the thick crowds. It then lay on a carpet as clerics stood praying behind.

Meanwhile hostilities with the United States have erupted again this week despite a truce, with Iran still controlling the vital Strait of Hormuz waterway and proclaiming its victory in having survived a months-long assault by its most powerful enemies, Israel and the US.

Iranian authorities are presenting Khamenei's burial and the huge crowds attending his funeral as evidence of the popularity of their theocratic state and its lasting ideological fire, nearly half a century after the 1979 Islamic revolution.

The whereabouts of Mojtaba Khamenei, proclaimed supreme leader by a clerical assembly in early March, a week after his father's death, has remained a mystery to Iranians.

He has not appeared in public since the US and Israel started the war with the strike that killed Ali Khamenei. While he has issued written statements, no image, video or voice recording of him has been issued.

Senior sources in Tehran have said he was injured in the strike and is recovering, but he has not yet been well enough to make public appearances. State security services are also trying to limit his exposure in the event of further attacks from the United States.

As crowds jostled in Mashhad awaiting Khamenei's funeral cortege, the crowd chanted slogans demanding revenge on US President Donald Trump for his killing.

“I swear by the blood of the supreme leader, Trump, we will kill you!” they shouted, with women holding up placards reading "Kill Trump".

The shrine's courtyard was a sea of mourners as dusk fell, their defiant chants of "Death to America" ringing out above the lyrical funeral laments and sorrowful string music broadcast by loudspeakers.

title.en: South Africa: Driven home by anti-migrant protests
title.zh: 南非：因反移民抗议活动被迫返乡

summary.en: Two women shared their experiences of being forced to leave South Africa and return to Zambia due to anti-migrant protests, having to restart their lives from nothing.
summary.zh: 两名妇女讲述了她们因南非的反移民抗议活动而被迫离开南非返回赞比亚，不得不从头开始重建生活的故事。

body.en:
Two women tell DW how anti-migrant protests upended their lives in South Africa, forcing them to return to Zambia and rebuild from scratch.

With her baby strapped to her back and carrying little more than the clothes she was wearing, Glenda Banda crossed back into Zambia amid growing anti-migrant sentiment in South Africa .

South Africa has been her home for a decade. It was where she found work, raised her family and hoped to build a better future. She told DW that within days, everything she had worked for was gone.

"I came with only the clothes on my body. I had no clothes to change into," Banda said, adding that the local mayor had sent young men to her home to ask the landlord to evict her and her family.

"The landlord was forced to put all our belongings outside and lock the house," Banda told DW. "We had to flee and leave everything behind."

Banda is among more than 100 Zambians who returned to their homeland after anti-migrant protests — some of which turned violent — called for migrants  to be sent back.

Bernadette Mwelwa tells a similar story. After living in South Africa for more than 20 years, she returned to Zambia having lost not only her livelihood but also the life she had built there.

"Even if you were a refugee or an asylum seeker , as long as you were a foreigner they didn't want us there," she said.

"I can't go back to South Africa because I lost a lot of things. The mayor took the keys to my salon," Mwelwa told DW. "I left my husband, who is Congolese, to look after our supermarket, but it was looted and everything is gone."

Nigeria, Mozambique and Ghana have all raised concerns about attacks on their citizens living in South Africa.

Nigeria  on Sunday denounced the deaths of two of its citizens in South Africa , warning that foreign nationals are being "unduly targeted" amid the anti-migrant protests. South Africa's main police watchdog said it had opened an investigation, Reuters reported.

Mozambique's government said five of its citizens were killed "as a direct consequence of the xenophobic attacks" that flared after a march against undocumented migrants in the South African town of Mossel Bay at the end of May. 

South African police ​said only two Mozambicans died after being assaulted following the march, and would not say if there was a link with anti-migrant sentiment, according to the news agency Associated Press. 

Ghana said last week one of its citizens was fatally wounded in a shooting during the anti-migrant demonstrations. South Africa said his killing was not related to the protests ​and accused Ghana of spreading misinformation .

body.zh: 两名妇女告诉德国之声，反移民抗议活动如何颠覆了她们在南非的生活，迫使她们返回赞比亚并从头开始重建。 格伦达·班达（Glenda Banda）背着孩子，除了身上穿的衣服外，几乎没有带任何东西，在南非反移民情绪日益高涨的情况下，她穿越回赞比亚。 十年来，南非一直是她的家。她在那里找到了工作，养育了家庭，并希望建立更美好的未来。她告诉德国之声，几天之内，她为之努力的一切都消失了。 班达说：“我只带着身上的衣服。我没有衣服可换。”她补充说，当地市长派了年轻人到她家，要求房东驱逐她和她的家人。 班达告诉德国之声：“房东被迫把我们所有的物品都放在外面，并锁上房子。” “我们不得不逃离并抛下一切。” 班达是在反移民抗议活动（其中一些抗议活动演变成暴力活动）要求遣返移民后返回祖国的 100 多名赞比亚人之一。 伯纳黛特·姆韦尔瓦 (Bernadette Mwelwa) 也讲述了类似的故事。在南非生活了20多年后，她回到赞比亚，不仅失去了生计，也失去了在那里建立的生活。 “即使你是难民或寻求庇护者，只要你是外国人，他们就不希望我们在那里，”她说。 姆韦尔瓦告诉德国之声：“我无法回到南非，因为我失去了很多东西。市长拿走了我沙龙的钥匙。” “我留下我的刚果人丈夫来照看我们的超市，但超市被洗劫一空，所有东西都消失了。” 尼日利亚、莫桑比克和加纳都对居住在南非的本国公民遭受袭击表示担忧。 尼日利亚周日谴责了两名尼日利亚公民在南非的死亡事件，并警告称，外国人在反移民抗议活动中成为“不当目标”。据路透社报道，南非主要警察监管机构表示已展开调查。 莫桑比克政府表示，五月底南非莫塞尔湾镇针对无证移民的游行后爆发的“仇外袭击直接导致”五名莫桑比克公民被杀。 据美联社报道，南非警方表示，只有两名莫桑比克人在游行后遭到袭击而死亡，并且不愿透露是否与反移民情绪有关。 加纳上周表示，一名公民在反移民示威期间的枪击事件中身亡。南非表示他的被杀与抗议活动无关​并指责加纳散布错误信息。 尽管许多移民仍留在南非，但在经历了数周的反移民情绪、威胁以及在一些地区……之后，数千人离开了南非。

reflection.en: The displacement of these women highlights the pain caused when communities reject those seeking a new home. Yahweh's ancient command reminds us to treat foreigners as native-born, loving them as ourselves, remembering our shared human vulnerability. This principle calls us to extend compassion and justice to all, regardless of their origin.
reflection.zh: 这些妇女的流离失所凸显了当社区排斥寻求新家园的人时所造成的痛苦。雅伟古老的诫命提醒我们，要善待寄居者如同本地人，爱他们如同爱自己，并记住我们共同的人性脆弱。这一原则呼吁我们对所有人，无论其出身如何，都施以怜悯和公义。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Congo: UN laments uptick in fighting in South Kivu
title.zh: 刚果：联合国哀叹南基伍省战事升级

summary.en: The UN human rights chief has urged an immediate end to intensified clashes between the army and the Rwanda-backed M23 militia in South Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo.
summary.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员呼吁刚果民主共和国东部南基伍省的军队与卢旺达支持的M23民兵组织之间日益激烈的冲突立即停止。

body.zh: 联合国人权事务高级专员呼吁立即停止刚果民主共和国东部的战斗。此前，军队与卢旺达支持的“M23”民兵在南基伍省发生了激烈冲突。 联合国人权事务高级专员沃尔克·蒂尔克周四呼吁各方停止在刚果民主共和国东部的敌对行动。 过去两周，刚果民主共和国武装部队与卢旺达军队支持的“M23”武装团体在南基伍边境地区的战斗愈演愈烈。 至少自 2021 年“M23”运动重新出现并在数十年来饱受冲突困扰的边境地区夺取大片领土以来，这场斗争一直在消退。 蒂尔克对最近南基伍省冲突对平民造成的影响表示遗憾，呼吁国家和国际社会共同努力缓和紧张局势。 图尔克说：“令人深感不安的是，尽管作为正在进行的和平进程的一部分达成了协议，但刚果民主共和国东部的战斗仍然有增无减——造成平民伤亡、流离失所，生计遭到破坏。” 尽管去年底在多哈达成了和平框架协议并受到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的赞扬，但 7 月 4 日至 5 日，菲齐的穆利马村周围仍发生了激烈的冲突，但该协议在制止战斗方面的行动相对较少。 图尔克表示：“我敦促刚果武装部队和‘3·23’运动立即停止进一步的暴力活动，并采取紧急行动缓和紧张局势。” “我还呼吁双方采取有意义的措施，保护穆利马以及更广泛的菲齐和姆文加高原地区的平民。在人口稠密地区使用具有大范围杀伤力的爆炸性武器会造成毁灭性后果，必须停止。” 图尔克办公室还在声明中表示，他“敦促卢旺达停止对“3·23”运动的支持，并从刚果民主共和国撤军”，同时敦促刚果民主共和国“加大”努力，“复员、解除武装和遣返卢旺达民主力量（FDLR）成员”，尽管没有直接引用奥地利官员的话。 联合国怀疑双方在最近南基伍省的战斗中都犯有战争罪。 南基伍省是刚果民主共和国的一个边境地区，与卢旺达接壤，富含黄金、锡矿石和钶钽矿储量，两国最近的共同历史极为紧张。 卢旺达内战，特别是 20 世纪 90 年代初的种族灭绝之后，数百万胡图族人——包括一些参与大规模屠杀图西族的人——逃到了当时被称为扎伊尔的地方。卢旺达及其盟国因此在1996年发起进攻，基加利也深度参与了第一次和第二次刚果战争……

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict in eastern Congo reminds us of the deep human longing for an end to violence. In times when peace seems elusive, we hold onto the hope that Yahweh is ultimately the one who can make wars cease. May this hope inspire continued efforts for reconciliation and stability in the region.

title.en: Iran after Khamenei: A new order takes shape
title.zh: 哈梅内伊之后的伊朗：新秩序正在形成

summary.en: Mojtaba Khamenei has become Iran's new supreme leader, inheriting a political system that his father spent decades developing and molding to his own vision.
summary.zh: 莫吉塔巴·哈梅内伊已成为伊朗新任最高领袖，他继承了其父数十年来建立并塑造成自己形象的政治体系。

body.en:
Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's new supreme leader, has inherited a political system that his father spent decades building and shaping in his own image.

The Islamic Republic of Iran is entering a new political era as Iranians on Thursday prepared to bury their slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei in his hometown of Mashhad in northeastern Iran.  

His son and successor Mojtaba Khamenei still remains hidden from public view after being disfigured in the US air strike that killed his father when the Iran war began on February 28.

The younger Khamenei — the Islamic Republic's third supreme leader since the 1979 Revolution — was conspicuously absent from even the official mourning ceremonies for his father.

This leadership transition in Iran represents far more than a simple change at the top of the state.

It is the culmination of a profound institutional transformation that unfolded during Ali Khamenei's nearly four decades in power.

Reza Talebi, a political analyst, said Khamenei gradually reshaped the power structures of the Islamic Republic.

"Unlike Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, who established a system after the revolution that rested on revolutionary legitimacy and his personal authority, Ali Khamenei began systematically restructuring that system,” Talebi told DW.

Over the past 37 years, the influence of senior clerics and Shiite semnaries over key political decisions has steadily diminished , he pointed out. In their place, security institutions, the Office of the Supreme Leader, and the political and military networks associated with it have become increasingly dominant, the expert added.

This transformation has also altered the role of Iran's elected institutions. In Talebi's view, presidential elections have increasingly evolved into contests conducted within a pre-defined political framework.

Although presidents from different political factions were able to pursue their own domestic priorities, they had limited room for maneuver in strategic areas such as foreign policy, the nuclear program, and regional affairs, Talebi said.

Notably, during the six-day state mourning ceremonies for Ali Khamenei, none of the Islamic Republic's three former living presidents — Hassan Rouhani, Mahmoud Ahmadinejad , and Mohammad Khatami —appeared alongside other leading figures of the political establishment.

Instead, official images focused on representatives of the security apparatus, particularly commanders of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), as well as incumbent President Masoud Pezeshkian.

Pezeshkian is widely believed to have maintained a close working relationship with Mojtaba Khamenei. He played a central role in negotiations aimed at ending the Iran war.

body.zh: 伊朗新任最高领袖莫吉塔巴·哈梅内伊继承了其父亲花费数十年时间按照自己的形象建立和塑造的政治制度。 伊朗伊斯兰共和国正在进入一个新的政治时代，伊朗人周四准备在伊朗东北部的家乡马什哈德埋葬被杀的最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊。 2 月 28 日伊朗战争爆发时，他的儿子兼继任者莫吉塔巴·哈梅内伊 (Mojtaba Khamenei) 在美国空袭中被毁容，导致其父亲身亡，至今仍隐藏在公众视线之外。 年轻的哈梅内伊——自 1979 年革命以来伊斯兰共和国的第三位最高领导人——甚至明显缺席了其父亲的官方哀悼仪式。 伊朗的领导层换届不仅仅意味着国家高层的简单变动。 这是阿里·哈梅内伊执政近四十年期间展开的深刻制度变革的顶峰。 政治分析家礼萨·塔莱比表示，哈梅内伊逐渐重塑了伊斯兰共和国的权力结构。 塔莱比告诉德国之声：“阿亚图拉鲁霍拉·霍梅尼在革命后建立了一个基于革命合法性和个人权威的体系，而阿里·哈梅内伊则开始系统性地重组该体系。” 他指出，过去37年里，高级神职人员和什叶派神学院对关键政治决策的影响力不断减弱。专家补充说，取而代之的是安全机构、最高领袖办公室以及与之相关的政治和军事网络，它们已变得越来越占主导地位。 这一转变也改变了伊朗民选机构的作用。在塔勒比看来，总统选举越来越演变成在预先确定的政治框架内进行的竞争。 塔莱比表示，尽管来自不同政治派别的总统能够追求自己的国内优先事项，但他们在外交政策、核计划和地区事务等战略领域的回旋余地有限。 值得注意的是，在阿里·哈梅内伊为期六天的国家哀悼仪式上，伊斯兰共和国三位在世前总统——哈桑·鲁哈尼、马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪内贾德和穆罕默德·哈塔米——都没有与政治机构的其他领导人一起出现。 相反，官方形象集中在安全机构的代表上，特别是伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）的指挥官，以及现任总统马苏德·佩泽什基安。 人们普遍认为佩泽什基安与莫杰塔巴·哈梅内伊保持着密切的工作关系。他在旨在结束伊朗战争的谈判中发挥了核心作用。 这场冲突于 2 月 28 日开始，与美国和...

reflection.en: As a new leader steps into power, the character of governance profoundly shapes the lives of a nation's people. Yahweh's word reminds us that the well-being of a society is deeply connected to the integrity and nature of its leadership.
reflection.zh: 当一位新领袖掌权时，治理的品格深刻地影响着一个民族的生活。雅伟的话语提醒我们，一个社会的福祉与领导层的正直和本质息息相关。

title.en: Iran strikes military sites in Gulf states after top negotiator's warning against US 'bullying'
title.zh: 伊朗在高级谈判代表警告美国“霸凌”后，袭击海湾国家的军事地点

summary.en: Iran launched attacks on military sites in Kuwait, Qatar, and Bahrain. These strikes occurred after recent US military actions against Iran's southern coastal and eastern provinces.
summary.zh: 在美军近期袭击了伊朗南部沿海和东部省份之后，伊朗对科威特、卡塔尔和巴林的军事地点发动了袭击。

body.en:
Iranian armed forces targeted United States military infrastructure in neighbouring Gulf states on Thursday following US strikes on Iran's southern coastal and eastern provinces, putting further strain on a three-week-old ceasefire agreement.

Iran was also preparing on Thursday to bury its slain Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei at the country's holiest shrine in Mashhad, in the northeast, the culmination of a week of mass funeral processions and rallies. Khamenei was killed in a US airstrike on the first day of the war on 28 February.

The US military said on Wednesday its latest strikes on Iran were aimed at keeping the Strait of Hormuz open after Iran targeted three tankers in the area.

The assault came hours after US President Donald Trump said he believed the interim ceasefire with Iran to be "over".

Iranian officials said the US attacks had killed 14 people and injured 78 across five provinces on 8 and 9 July, state media reported. The Fars news agency said one US strike had hit a rail bridge used for trade with Russia and China.

Several explosions were heard on Thursday morning in Iran's Bushehr province, the semi-official Mehr news agency reported. Bushehr is home to a Russian-built nuclear power plant.

Iran's army said in a statement released by state media that it had targeted US Patriot systems with drones in Kuwait, an early warning site in Qatar (satellite antenna) and a fuel storage facility of the US army in Bahrain.

Kuwait said its armed forces had engaged with a cruise missile, three ballistic missiles and 10 drones in its airspace, and that one person had been injured from falling shrapnel.

Qatar, which hosts the largest US military base in the region and has often mediated between Washington and its adversaries, including Tehran, called for a return to diplomacy.

In a phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Aragchi, Qatar's Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman al-Thani also condemned attacks targeting commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

While Iran has not claimed responsibility for the ship attacks, analysts say Tehran uses such actions to gain leverage in negotiations.

The Strait of Hormuz handled about a fifth of global oil supplies before the war erupted on 28 February with US and Israeli strikes against Iran.

Tehran has since taken effective control of the strait, allowing it to force a stalemate in its confrontation with the world's most powerful military.

title.en: Uranium, universities, and 'top-tier' security: Inside the new Albanese-Modi agreements
title.zh: 铀、大学和“顶级”安全：阿尔巴尼斯-莫迪新协议的内幕

summary.en: Australia and India have signed new agreements covering defence, uranium, and university partnerships, marking a shift from their traditional rivalry in sports to a strategic alliance.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚和印度签署了新的协议，涵盖国防、铀和大学合作，标志着两国从传统的体育竞争对手转变为战略盟友。

body.en:
A handshake and a smile sealed the deal between Australia and its "top-tier" security partner, as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese and his Indian counterpart, Narendra Modi, pledged to strengthen ties across trade, education, defence, science and technology.

" While we are separated by an ocean, we are indeed the closest of friends," Albanese told reporters in Canberra during a joint press statement.

"Australia values India as a top-tier security partner, and the Declaration reflects our shared commitment to a peaceful, stable and prosperous Indo-Pacific region."

References to cricket embraced the common ground between the two nations, with Modi likening their partnership to a "long and intense test match".

However, underneath the sports metaphors was an undercurrent of concern around the Indo-Pacific's defence challenges, with one eye on the fallout of war in Iran and economic disruptions, and the other on China, just days after it conducted a missile test in the Pacific .

Central to the agreement is the vision of a stable, peaceful and prosperous Indo-Pacific.

To get there, Albanese and Modi both pledged to strengthen defence ties between the two nations.

While no new partnership was announced, the two leaders confirmed their commitment to existing defence pledges, the most recent being the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership established in 2020.

" We will boost strategic coordination, increase the complexity of our defence exercises and further build interoperability between our defence forces," Albanese said.

" We have endorsed a joint maritime security collaboration roadmap and agreed to a new Australia-India partnership on cyber, critical technologies and supply chains."

India and Australia have opened the door to greater aircraft deployment in each other's territories, and there will be more exchanges, education, and training between the defence personnel of each nation.

They will also increase information sharing on terrorist threats in the region, terrorist financing and online radicalisation.

The strengthening of defence ties comes just two days after China tested a nuclear-capable missile in the Pacific.

"There is no doubt that this is a provocative act by China which does destabilise the region," Albanese said at the time.

"Today we can confirm the signing of the administrative arrangement to export uranium to India for peaceful purposes under the 2015 Australia-India nuclear cooperative agreement," Albanese told reporters in Canberra.

title.en: Is the Strait of Hormuz still Iran's trump card?
title.zh: 霍尔木兹海峡仍是伊朗的王牌吗？

summary.en: Iran's recent actions demonstrate its capacity to disrupt global shipping and energy markets, potentially drawing in neighboring Gulf states. The article examines Iran's actual leverage over Washington and the possible repercussions of its high-risk approach.
summary.zh: 伊朗最近的行动表明，它有能力扰乱全球航运和能源市场，并可能牵连海湾邻国。文章探讨了德黑兰对华盛顿的实际影响力，以及其高风险策略可能带来的反作用。

body.en:
Iran's latest attacks show it can easily disrupt shipping, energy markets and draw in Gulf neighbors. DW asks how much leverage Tehran really has over Washington and if its high-risk strategy could backfire.

The Iran war has reignited after Tehran struck at least three commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, according to US and maritime officials.

The attacks, which targeted a Saudi oil tanker and a Qatari liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier, prompted the United States  to revoke the temporary sanctions waiver on Iranian oil exports.

This major concession in the memorandum of understanding (MOU) agreed by the US and Iran last month allowed Tehran to restart oil exports after its tankers were halted by a US Navy blockade.

In further retaliation, US Central Command (CENTCOM) said Wednesday it had struck more than 80 targets in Iran, including air defense systems, radars and over 60 small boats used by Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) to harass shipping .

The US military said it followed up Thursday with a fresh round of strikes on around 90 targets.

CENTCOM said it wanted to "impose heavy costs for targeting and attacking commercial shipping crewed by innocent civilians in an international waterway."

Iran then hit back by launching fresh missile strikes on Gulf nations on Wednesday, with air raid sirens and explosions reported in Bahrain and Kuwait . Further strikes were reported Thursday.

Traffic through the strait, which had restarted after the ceasefire deal, had again grinded to a halt, Bloomberg reported on Thursday, citing shipping tracking data.

Reacting to the escalation, maritime security firm MARISKS warned Wednesday that the tit-for-tat action "marks a return to direct military confrontation."

Speaking ahead of a NATO summit in Turkey, US President Donald Trump said the MOU with Iran was now "over," adding that "It’s just a waste of time dealing with them [Tehran]."

China and Qatar, meanwhile, called for an immediate de-escalation, while German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius called on Tehran to stop provoking Washington and cease attacks on vessels.

Iran is trying to maintain its control over Hormuz, the narrow waterway that before the war carried a fifth of the world's oil and gas exports from the Gulf to the rest of the world.

Iran effectively closed the strait after US-Israeli airstrikes killed several Iranian officials, including Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei , on February 28. Later, Iran struck around a dozen ships caught in the strait, before a fragile ceasefire deal was reached last month.

body.zh: 伊朗最近的袭击表明，它可以轻易扰乱航运、能源市场并吸引海湾邻国。德国之声询问德黑兰对华盛顿到底有多大影响力，以及其高风险策略是否会适得其反。 据美国和海事官员称，德黑兰周二在霍尔木兹海峡袭击了至少三艘商船，伊朗战争重新燃起。 这些袭击针对一艘沙特油轮和一艘卡塔尔液化天然气（LNG）运输船，促使美国撤销对伊朗石油出口的临时制裁豁免。 美国和伊朗上个月达成的谅解备忘录（MOU）中的这一重大让步允许德黑兰在其油轮因美国海军封锁而停止后重新启动石油出口。 作为进一步报复，美国中央司令部 (CENTCOM) 周三表示，它袭击了伊朗 80 多个目标，包括防空系统、雷达和伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队 (IRGC) 用于骚扰航运的 60 多艘小船。 美国军方表示，周四对大约 90 个目标进行了新一轮打击。 中央司令部表示，它希望“对国际水道上由无辜平民驾驶的商业船只进行瞄准和攻击，造成沉重代价”。 伊朗周三对海湾国家发动了新的导弹袭击进行反击，据报道巴林和科威特响起空袭警报并发生爆炸。周四报道了进一步的罢工。 彭博社周四援引航运跟踪数据报道称，停火协议后恢复的海峡交通再次陷入停滞。 针对事态升级，海事安全公司 MARISKS 周三警告称，这一针锋相对的行动“标志着直接军事对抗的回归”。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在土耳其举行的北约峰会前发表讲话时表示，与伊朗的谅解备忘录现已“结束”，并补充说“与他们（德黑兰）打交道只是浪费时间。” 与此同时，中国和卡塔尔呼吁立即降级，德国国防部长鲍里斯·皮斯托利斯则呼吁德黑兰停止挑衅华盛顿并停止袭击船只。 伊朗正试图维持对霍尔木兹海峡的控制，这条狭窄的水道在战前将世界五分之一的石油和天然气从海湾出口到世界其他地区。 2 月 28 日，美国和以色列的空袭杀死了包括最高领袖哈梅内伊在内的几名伊朗官员，之后伊朗实际上关闭了该海峡。随后，伊朗又袭击了被困在海峡中的十几艘船只，直到上个月达成一项脆弱的停火协议。 在周二袭击发生前的几天里，和平谈判在许多悬而未决的问题上几乎没有取得进展，包括美国的长期问题……

title.en: China lands reusable rocket for first time, state media says
title.zh: 中国首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，官方媒体报道

summary.en: China has successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time, according to state media. This achievement follows similar successful landings by US companies SpaceX and Blue Origin.
summary.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，中国首次成功实现可重复使用火箭着陆。此前，美国公司SpaceX和Blue Origin也曾成功实现类似的可重复使用火箭着陆。

body.en:
China has successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in a major breakthrough for the country's space programme, according to state media.

The China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation said the Long March 10B rocket lifted off from Hainan in southern China at 12:15 local time (04:15GMT) on Friday.

Around six minutes after separating from the rocket's upper stage, its booster returned to Earth vertically and was recovered on a floating platform.

It signals that China may be able to challenge America's dominance in reusable rockets after successful landings by Elon Musk's SpaceX and Blue Origin, which is owned by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos.

Rockets are typically considered expendable - their various segments being discarded and destroyed during ascent - which makes launching spacecraft expensive.

By reusing boosters - which are generally seen as the most valuable part of a rocket - the cost of satellite launches and space exploration can be significantly lowered.

In December 2015, SpaceX landed a reusable Falcon 9 rocket from an orbital flight for the first time, followed by Blue Origin's New Glenn in November 2025.

The Falcon 9 now launches about 150 times a year with boosters that are capable of being reused dozens of times.

China made its first attempt at reusable rocket recovery in February, with a Long March 10A rocket. It completed a controlled descent and splashed down next to a recovery platform.

The Long March 10B, which can carry a payload of at least 16 metric tons to low-Earth orbit, has been compared to SpaceX's Falcon 9.

But unlike the Falcon 9, the Long March 10B does not autonomously land on a ground pad or drone ship. Instead "landing hooks" on the rocket catch a net attached to a floating platform.

Shares in Chinese space firms jumped following the news, with China Spacesat and China Satellite Communications each rising by 10%, the daily limit allowed by the country's financial market regulations.
body.zh: 据官方媒体报道，中国首次成功着陆可重复使用火箭，这是中国太空计划的重大突破。 中国航天科技集团公司表示，长征十号乙运载火箭于当地时间周五中午 12 点 15 分（格林威治标准时间 04 点 15 分）从中国南部的海南岛升空。 与火箭上级分离后大约六分钟，其助推器垂直返回地球，并在浮动平台上回收。 这标志着，在埃隆·马斯克(Elon Musk)的SpaceX和亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝佐斯(Jeff Bezos)旗下的蓝色起源(Blue Origin)成功着陆后，中国可能能够挑战美国在可重复使用火箭方面的主导地位。 火箭通常被认为是消耗性的——它们的各个部分在上升过程中被丢弃和毁坏——这使得发射航天器变得昂贵。 通过重复使用助推器（通常被视为火箭最有价值的部分），可以显着降低卫星发射和太空探索的成本。 2015 年 12 月，SpaceX 首次将可重复使用的猎鹰 9 号火箭从轨道飞行中着陆，随后蓝色起源的新格伦火箭于 2025 年 11 月着陆。 目前，猎鹰 9 号火箭每年发射约 150 次，其助推器可重复使用数十次。 今年二月，中国首次尝试使用长征十号甲运载火箭进行可重复使用火箭回收。它完成了受控下降并溅落在回收平台旁边。 长征十号B可以将至少16吨的有效载荷运送到近地轨道，有人将其与SpaceX的猎鹰9号进行比较。 但与猎鹰 9 号不同的是，长征十号 B 不能自动降落在地面垫或无人机船上。相反，火箭上的“着陆钩”抓住了连接在浮动平台上的网。 消息传出后，中国航天公司的股价大幅上涨，中国航天和中国卫星通信股价均上涨 10%，这是中国金融市场法规允许的涨停板。

reflection.en: This technological milestone reflects humanity's persistent drive to explore and innovate, echoing the biblical observation that knowledge will increase. Such advancements remind us of the incredible capacity for discovery Yahweh has placed within us, inviting us to steward these gifts responsibly for the good of all.
reflection.zh: 这一技术里程碑反映了人类探索和创新的不懈动力，呼应了圣经中关于知识将不断增长的论述。此类进步提醒我们雅伟赋予人类的惊人发现能力，邀请我们负责任地管理这些恩赐，造福全人类。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Factory fire kills at least 28 in China's 'shoe capital'
title.zh: 工厂火灾在中国“鞋都”造成至少28人死亡

summary.en: A factory fire in China's "shoe capital" has killed at least 28 people. Footage showed large flames and thick, black smoke rising from the building.
summary.zh: 中国“鞋都”一家工厂发生火灾，造成至少28人死亡。视频显示，大火从建筑物中蹿出，浓烟滚滚升向天空。

body.en:
A fire at a shoe factory in the south-eastern Chinese city of Jinjiang has killed at least 28 people, according to the state news agency.

Dramatic footage posted by Xinhua showed huge plumes of black smoke rising from a building as well as people who appeared to be trapped on the roof.

President Xi Jinping said the blaze had caused "major casualties", adding those responsible must be held "strictly accountable".

Jinjiang, in the province of Fujian, is often referred to as China's "shoe capital" as it reportedly manufactures 20% of the world's sports shoes.

The blaze erupted at the Huiteng Footwear factory at around noon local time (05:00 BST) on Thursday.

Authorities dispatched more than 500 personnel to extinguish the blaze and rescue people, state media reported.

State media also reported that there were nearly 240 people at the factory when the fire broke out.

Among the 213 people who were evacuated, two of them later died in hospital. Twenty-six others, who had been initially missing, were found dead.

Initial reports suggest the fire may have started on the factory's ground floor where flammable materials were stored.

Authorities have detained a number of people who work for the factory's owners, and the firm's bank account was frozen, according to state media.

China started a campaign to prevent fires in high-rise buildings after a blaze ripped through several Hong Kong apartment buildings in November , killing 168 people.

Xi said Chinese officials must draw "profound lessons" from "several major industrial safety accidents" in the country this year.
body.zh: 据国家通讯社报道，中国东南部城市晋江一家鞋厂发生火灾，已造成至少 28 人死亡。 新华社发布的戏剧性画面显示，一座建筑物冒出巨大的黑烟，人们似乎被困在屋顶上。 习近平主席表示，火灾造成“重大人员伤亡”，并补充说必须“严肃追究责任者”。 福建省晋江经常被称为中国的“鞋都”，因为据报道，该市生产了全球 20% 的运动鞋。 当地时间周四中午（英国夏令时 05:00）左右，辉腾鞋业工厂发生火灾。 据官方媒体报道，当局出动了 500 多名人员扑灭大火并营救人员。 官方媒体还报道称，火灾发生时工厂内有近240人。 被疏散的213人中，有两人后来在医院死亡。最初失踪的另外 26 人被发现死亡。 初步报告显示，火灾可能是从工厂存放易燃材料的底层开始的。 据官方媒体报道，当局拘留了一些为该工厂老板工作的人员，该公司的银行账户也被冻结。 11 月，香港几栋公寓楼发生火灾，造成 168 人死亡，之后中国启动了高层建筑防火行动。 习近平表示，中国官员必须从今年发生的“几起重大工业安全事故”中吸取“深刻教训”。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in this factory fire reminds us of the profound value of every worker and the conditions in which they labor. Yahweh hears the cries of those who toil, and calls for justice and safety in all workplaces. This incident prompts us to reflect on our responsibility to ensure that all labor is conducted with dignity and protection.
reflection.zh: 这场工厂火灾中生命的悲剧性逝去，提醒我们每位工人的宝贵价值以及他们劳作的环境。雅伟听见劳苦者的呼声，并呼吁所有工作场所都应有公义和安全。这起事件促使我们反思，确保所有劳动都应在尊严和保护下进行，是我们的责任。

verse.textEn: Look! The wages you failed to pay the workers who mowed your fields are crying out against you. The cries of the harvesters have reached the ears of Yahweh Almighty.
verse.textZh: 工人给你们收割庄稼，你们亏欠他们的工钱，这工钱有声音呼叫，并且那收割之人的冤声已经入了万军之主的耳了。

title.en: China: Dozens killed in shoe factory fire
title.zh: 中国：鞋厂火灾致数十人死亡

summary.en: Dozens of people were killed in a shoe factory fire in Jinjiang, China, with hundreds of rescue workers dispatched to the site. President Xi Jinping indicated that "heavy human losses" were anticipated.
summary.zh: 中国晋江一家鞋厂发生火灾，造成数十人死亡，数百名救援人员被派往现场。习近平主席表示预计将有“重大人员伤亡”。

body.en:
Hundreds of rescue workers were dispatched to the site in Jinjiang, China, where many had become trapped in a burning factory. President Xi Jinping said "heavy human losses" were expected.

At least 28 people were killed in a fire at a shoe factory in eastern China on Thursday.

China's Ministry of Emergency Management announced that some 200 fire and rescue workers had been dispatched to a shoe factory in Fujian province on Thursday.

President Xi Jinping has called for "an all-out search and rescue effort" and a swift investigation in order to "strictly hold those responsible accountable."

Dozens of fire trucks were seen dumping water on the burnt multi-story factory as smoke continued to billow from the site.

"Simultaneously, the cause of the fire must be investigated, lessons learned, and effective measures taken to prevent similar accidents from recurring," the ministry said in a statement.

Beijing launched a renewed campaign to bring high-rise buildings and factories in line with fire codes in November after 168 people were killed in Hong Kong where several tower blocks went up in flames.
body.zh: 数百名救援人员被派往中国晋江的现场，许多人被困在一座着火的工厂里。习近平主席表示，预计将造成“严重人员伤亡”。 周四，中国东部一家鞋厂发生火灾，造成至少 28 人死亡。 中国应急管理部周四宣布，已派出约200名消防救援人员前往福建省一家鞋厂。 习近平主席呼吁“全力搜救”，迅速展开调查，“严肃追究责任人的责任”。 人们看到数十辆消防车向被烧毁的多层工厂倾倒水，现场浓烟继续滚滚。 公安部在一份声明中表示：“同时，必须调查起火原因，吸取教训，并采取有效措施，防止类似事故再次发生。” 11 月，香港多座高楼起火，导致 168 人死亡，北京方面重新启动了一项行动，要求高层建筑和工厂遵守消防规范。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the factory fire brings immense sorrow and reminds us of the fragility of human existence. In moments of such profound grief, we hold onto the promise that one day Yahweh will wipe away every tear. This hope assures us that death, mourning, crying, and pain will ultimately cease.
reflection.zh: 这场工厂火灾中生命的悲惨逝去带来了巨大的悲伤，也提醒我们人类生命的脆弱。在如此深重的悲痛时刻，我们紧紧抓住雅伟有一天将擦去我们所有眼泪的应许。这个盼望向我们保证，死亡、悲哀、哭号和疼痛终将止息。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Venomous snakes escape breeding farms in southern China during flooding

summary.zh: 中国南方多地遭受严重风暴袭击，台风“美莎克”引发洪水，导致数百条蛇，包括王锦蛇和眼镜蛇，从被淹的养殖场逃逸。

body.en: Local media in Hengzhou report king ratsnakes and cobras among hundreds in flood waters caused by typhoon Maysak Hundreds of snakes, including cobras, have escaped from flooded breeding farms in southern China as severe storms continue to batter parts of the country. State media reported that a snake farm in Hengzhou, in Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, was hit by flood waters after days of heavy rainfall caused by typhoon Maysak , prompting warnings for nearby residents. Continue reading...
body.zh: 衡州当地媒体报道称，台风“美莎克”引发的洪水中，有数百条蛇王和眼镜蛇。随着严重风暴继续袭击中国部分地区，包括眼镜蛇在内的数百条蛇从中国南部被洪水淹没的养殖场中逃出。官方媒体报道称，台风“美莎”连日来带来强降雨，广西壮族自治区横州的一个养蛇场遭到洪水袭击，附近居民收到警告。继续阅读...

Romans 8:22 speaks to how the whole creation groans under the weight of disruption, a reality keenly felt when disasters lead to unexpected dangers. In such times, we are called to care for both human safety and the wider...
reflection.zh: 毒蛇在严重洪水中逃逸，提醒我们面对强大自然力量时，受造界的脆弱性。罗马书8:22提到整个受造界都在劳苦叹息，当灾难带来意想不到的危险时，这种感受尤为强烈。在这样的时刻，我们蒙召要关顾人类安全和更广阔的自然界，信靠雅伟最终的掌权。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Typhoon, tornadoes, landslides: deadly weather ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 台风、龙卷风、山体滑坡：致命天气肆虐中国（图）

summary.en: Typhoon Maysak and severe storms, including tornadoes and landslides, have caused widespread devastation across China, resulting in at least 15 fatalities in Guangxi and Hubei provinces.
summary.zh: 台风“美莎克”和包括龙卷风、山体滑坡在内的严重风暴在中国各地造成了广泛破坏，导致广西和湖北省至少15人死亡。

reflection.en: In the face of devastating natural disasters like typhoons and tornadoes, human vulnerability is starkly revealed. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos and loss, we can find solace in the enduring presence of the Divine.
reflection.zh: 面对台风和龙卷风等毁灭性的自然灾害，人类的脆弱性显露无遗。诗篇46:1提醒我们，雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱和损失之中，我们也能在神永恒的同在中找到慰藉。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: German car industry warns of job collapse unless ‘bold decisions’ made to address Chinese threat
title.zh: 德国汽车工业警告称，除非做出“大胆决定”应对中国威胁，否则将面临就业岗位崩溃

summary.en: The German car industry has issued a stark warning about a potential collapse of employment in the sector across Europe, proposing up to 100,000 job losses at Volkswagen and suggesting that car plants might need to be placed under foreign ownership to safeguard remaining jobs amidst growing competition from China.
summary.zh: 德国汽车工业发出严峻警告，称除非做出“大胆决定”以应对来自中国的威胁，否则欧洲汽车行业的就业岗位可能面临崩溃。大众汽车公司提议裁员多达10万人，并表示为保住剩余工作岗位，汽车工厂可能需要由外国公司持有。

body.en: VW to propose 100,000 job losses to board and says car plants could be put under foreign ownership to save jobs Europe live – latest updates The German car industry has warned of a potential collapse of employment in the sector in Europe unless society and workers accept that “bold decisions” are needed to address competition from the Chinese and other rivals. Volkswagen is preparing to formally propose up to 100,000 job losses , a move that has triggered a wave of protests. Continue reading...
body.zh: 大众汽车提议裁员10万人，并表示汽车工厂可能会被外资所有，以挽救欧洲的就业机会——最新动态 德国汽车行业警告称，除非社会和工人接受需要“大胆决定”来应对来自中国和其他竞争对手的竞争，否则欧洲该行业的就业可能会崩溃。大众汽车准备正式提出最多裁员10万人，此举引发了一波抗议浪潮。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As the German car industry faces significant challenges and potential job losses, this news highlights the deep human impact of economic shifts on livelihoods and communities. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to approach all our work with diligence and integrity, as if serving Yahweh Himself, finding purpose and dignity in our labor even amidst uncertainty.
reflection.zh: 随着德国汽车工业面临严峻挑战和潜在的失业危机，这则新闻凸显了经济转型对生计和社区的深刻影响。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给雅伟做的，不是给人做的，这让我们在不确定性中也能在工作中找到目的和尊严。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Plenty of players but no grassroots: can China ever grow into a footballing giant?
title.zh: 球员众多但缺乏基层：中国能否成长为足球巨头？

summary.en: Experts note that despite large crowds at amateur matches, China lacks a robust grassroots system to develop players into professionals, hindering its ambition to become a footballing giant.
summary.zh: 专家指出，尽管中国业余足球比赛吸引了大量观众，但缺乏健全的基层体系将球员培养成职业选手，这阻碍了其成为足球强国的雄心。

body.en: Some of its amateur matches pull in bigger crowds than European leagues but are more of a spectacle than a pathway to the professional game, say experts Michael Owen, a man who once quipped he had never drunk tea or coffee, isn’t known for his adventurous palate. Safe to assume, then, that the former England striker was out of his comfort zone sipping Roxburgh rose juice and eating chilli-wrapped rice noodle rolls during his recent visit to south-west China’s Guizhou province. The 2001 Ballon d’Or winner dusted off his boots for a match in Rongjiang county, the birthplace of viral amateur football league Cun Chao, also known as the Village Super League. Scoring twice in a 4-3 loss for local side Rongjiang Niubi, Owen endeared himself to the thousands in attendance, even if some weren’t familiar with the former Liverpool and Real Madrid player. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家迈克尔·欧文(Michael Owen)表示，它的一些业余比赛比欧洲联赛吸引了更多的观众，但更多的是一场奇观，而不是进入职业比赛的途径。迈克尔·欧文曾打趣说自己从未喝过茶或咖啡，但他并不以冒险的味觉而闻名。那么，可以肯定的是，这位前英格兰前锋在最近访问中国西南部的贵州省期间，已经走出了自己的舒适区，喝着罗克斯堡玫瑰汁，吃着辣椒卷。这位2001年金球奖得主在榕江县的一场比赛中掸掉了靴子上的灰尘，那里是风靡一时的业余足球联赛存超（也称为乡村超级联赛）的发源地。在当地球队榕江牛鼻子队以4-3输球的比赛中，欧文梅开二度，赢得了数千名现场观众的喜爱，尽管有些人对这位前利物浦和皇家马德里球员并不熟悉。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The challenge of building a strong football culture from the ground up highlights the importance of foundational development. Just as a child needs careful guidance and training to flourish, so too does any endeavor require intentional investment in its earliest stages to achieve lasting success. This reminds us that true growth often begins with nurturing...
reflection.zh: 从基层建立强大足球文化的挑战，突显了基础发展的重要性。正如孩子需要细心引导和培养才能茁壮成长，任何事业也需要对其早期阶段进行有意识的投入，才能取得持久的成功。这提醒我们，真正的成长往往始于在基层培养潜力。

verse.textZh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。

title.en: China's missile test builds on Pacific nuclear deterrence
title.zh: 中国导弹试验增强太平洋核威慑

summary.en: US allies in the Pacific have condemned China's recent intercontinental ballistic missile test, which Beijing described as routine. The test is seen as a demonstration of China's increasing military capabilities.
summary.zh: 太平洋地区的美国盟友谴责了中国最近进行的洲际弹道导弹试验，北京称之为“例行”测试。此次试验被视为中国展示其日益增长的军事能力。

body.en:
US allies in the Pacific condemned what Beijing has called a "routine" intercontinental ballistic missile test, which comes as China seeks to demonstrate its growing military capabilities.

On Monday, the Chinese Navy conducted a missile test in the South Pacific , with state media reporting that a nuclear submarine fired a missile carrying a dummy warhead into international waters.

The test quickly drew harsh criticism from US allies in the Pacific. Australia's Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the Chinese test was destabilizing for regional security. Japan called on China to reconsider its actions.

New Zealand said it does not want China to use the South Pacific as a testing ground for missiles. "We are deeply concerned about China's tests of nuclear-capable weapons in the South Pacific," Foreign Minister Winston Peters said in Wellington

During the Cold War, the US tested numerous nuclear weapons around the South Pacific's Bikini Atoll, which today is part of the Marshall Islands. Since World War II, the US has dominated the postwar security architecture in the Pacific region .

China's military buildup is now challenging this construct . Although official media have not released any details about the test, nationalist military experts are speculating on Chinese social media about how powerful the tested missile might have been.

"It is a submarine-launched intercontinental ballistic missile of the Julang (JL)-3 series," wrote Lieutenant Colonel Zhang Junshe a researcher with the People's Liberation Army (PLA) Naval Military Academic Research Institute.

The Julang-3, which means "Giant Wave-3" in English, is currently still under development.

It is said to have a maximum range of 12,000 kilometers (7,400 miles) and can carry multiple nuclear warheads. So far, three successful tests have been reported between 2018 and 2019.

"The target of this missile is not combat troops on the front lines, but strategic targets such as command centers, military bases, or energy infrastructure," Zhang wrote in his blog.

The "Giant Wave-3" is believed to have been launched from a Type 094 Jin-class nuclear-powered submarine. With a full crew of 120 sailors, the 135-meter-long submarine can sustain a submerged crew for at least 70 days. Currently, the Chinese Navy has six Type 094 submarines in service.

According to the Nuclear Threat Initiative, a Washington-based think tank, China operates an additional 59 nuclear-powered attack submarines in addition to the Jin-class submarines.

"Even if all other military weapons were to be put out of action, the Chinese submarine would still be fully capable of launching a nuclear counterstrike," Zhang wrote.

As early as September 2024, China had launched an intercontinental missile carrying a dummy warhead from the...
body.zh: 美国在太平洋的盟友谴责北京所谓的“例行”洲际弹道导弹试验，此次试验是在中国寻求展示其不断增长的军事能力之际进行的。 周一，中国海军在南太平洋进行了一次导弹试验，官方媒体报道称，一艘核潜艇向国际水域发射了一枚携带假弹头的导弹。 这次试验很快引起了美国太平洋盟友的严厉批评。澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤表示，中国的试验破坏了地区安全的稳定。日本呼吁中国重新考虑其行动。 新西兰表示不希望中国利用南太平洋作为导弹试验场。外交部长温斯顿·彼得斯在惠灵顿表示：“我们对中国在南太平洋进行核武器试验深感担忧” 冷战期间，美国在南太平洋比基尼环礁（今天是马绍尔群岛的一部分）周围测试了许多核武器。二战以来，美国一直主导着太平洋地区的战后安全架构。 中国的军力建设现在正在挑战这种结构。尽管官方媒体尚未公布有关此次测试的任何细节，但民族主义军事专家正在中国社交媒体上猜测测试的导弹的威力可能有多大。 中国人民解放军海军军事学术研究院研究员张军社中校写道：“这是巨狼（JL）-3系列潜射洲际弹道导弹。” Julang-3，英文意思是“Giant Wave-3”，目前仍在开发中。 据称其最大射程为12,000公里（7,400英里），可携带多枚核弹头。到目前为止，2018 年至 2019 年间已报告了三项成功的测试。 张在博客中写道：“这种导弹的目标不是前线的作战部队，而是指挥中心、军事基地或能源基础设施等战略目标。” 据信“巨浪3”是从一艘094型晋级核动力潜艇上发射的。这艘135米长的潜艇共有120名水手，可以让水下船员至少生存70天。目前，中国海军有6艘094型潜艇在役。 据华盛顿智库核威胁倡议组织称，除了晋级潜艇之外，中国还拥有59艘核动力攻击潜艇。 张写道：“即使所有其他军事武器都无法发挥作用，中国潜艇仍然完全有能力发动核反击。” 早在2024年9月，中国就从...发射了一枚携带假弹头的洲际导弹。

reflection.en: The news of missile tests highlights the ongoing global pursuit of security through military strength. Yet, the prophet Isaiah envisioned a future where nations would transform instruments of war into tools for peace, no longer training for conflict. This vision reminds us to pray for leaders to seek true security not in escalating arms, but in pathways of...
reflection.zh: 导弹试验的消息凸显了全球通过军事力量寻求安全的持续努力。然而，先知以赛亚曾预见一个未来，各国将把战争工具变为和平工具，不再为冲突而训练。这一愿景提醒我们为领袖祷告，愿他们不在军备竞赛中寻求真正的安全，而是在相互理解和裁军的道路上。

title.en: How do Australia's 'great deals' with its neighbours compare to China?
title.zh: 澳大利亚与邻国的“大交易”与中国相比如何？

summary.en: Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is strengthening diplomatic and economic ties with Pacific island nations, a region where China has significant influence.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚总理安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯正在加强与太平洋岛国的外交和经济关系，该地区是中国具有重要影响力的区域。

body.en:
Anthony Albanese is turning his attention to the Solomon Islands after securing Australia a major new defence agreement with Fiji, as he seeks to shore up support against the expansion of Chinese influence in the region.

Albanese and Fijian Prime Minister Sitiveni Rabuka formalised the Ocean of Peace Alliance alongside an updated Vuvale Union partnership during a ceremony in the Fijian capital Suva on Monday.

Albanese hailed the treaties, aimed at strengthening regional security amid intensifying strategic competition in the Pacific, as "one of the most significant endeavours Australia has undertaken with any country".

Fiji is one of Australia's closest Pacific security partners and has one of the region's largest militaries, making the agreement one of Canberra's most noteworthy in the Pacific.

The visit to Suva is part of a days-long diplomatic mission during which Albanese will meet with several regional leaders including Solomon Islands counterpart Matthew Wale for a whistle-stop tour on Tuesday, with the focus on a new comprehensive treaty.

The leaders last week agreed to start talks on a treaty to "capture the two countries' joint ambition for the relationship".

This latest push from Albanese comes as China confirmed on Monday it successfully tested a submarine-launched ballistic missile carried by a strategic nuclear submarine in international waters in the Pacific Ocean.

The agreements with Fiji expand the two nations' long-standing security and development relationship and introduce a mutual defence commitment.

The new Ocean of Peace Alliance commits both countries to consult and respond to security developments that threaten the sovereignty, peace or stability of either nation.

"Each Party recognises that an armed attack on any of the Parties within the Pacific would be dangerous to each other's peace and security as well as the security of the Pacific, and declares that it would act to meet the common danger, in accordance with its domestic processes," the deal reads.

Australia will support the partnership with more than $1 billion in funding over the next decade, targeting transnational crime prevention and investing in education, healthcare, and infrastructure projects in Fiji.

Australia works with all 14 Pacific Island nations to varying degrees, and has major security agreements with Papua New Guinea, Fiji, Solomon Islands, Vanuatu, Tuvalu and Nauru.

It also cooperates with other nations in the region, from foreign aid and infrastructure funding to marine surveillance and peacekeeping.

Henry Ivarature, a Pacific fellow with the Australia Pacific Security College at the Australian...
body.zh: 在澳大利亚与斐济达成一项重要的新防务协议后，安东尼·阿尔巴内塞将注意力转向所罗门群岛，寻求支持反对中国在该地区扩张的影响力。 阿尔巴尼亚和斐济总理西蒂维尼·拉布卡周一在斐济首都苏瓦举行的仪式上正式成立了和平海洋联盟，并更新了武瓦莱联盟伙伴关系。 阿尔巴尼斯称赞这些旨在在太平洋地区战略竞争加剧的情况下加强地区安全的条约是“澳大利亚与任何国家所做的最重要的努力之一”。 斐济是澳大利亚最亲密的太平洋安全伙伴之一，并拥有该地区最大的军队之一，这使得该协议成为堪培拉在太平洋地区最值得关注的协议之一。 对苏瓦的访问是为期几天的外交访问的一部分，在此期间，阿尔巴内斯将于周二与包括所罗门群岛同行马修·韦尔在内的几位地区领导人进行短暂停留，重点讨论一项新的全面条约。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 两国领导人上周同意开始就一项条约进行谈判，以“体现两国对两国关系的共同抱负”。 阿尔巴尼斯提出这一最新举措之际，中国周一证实在太平洋国际水域成功试射了一艘战略核潜艇携带的潜射弹道导弹。 与斐济的协议扩大了两国长期的安全和发展关系，并引入了共同防御承诺。 新的和平海洋联盟要求两国就威胁两国主权、和平或稳定的安全事态发展进行磋商和做出反应。 协议中写道：“各方认识到，对太平洋地区任何一方的武装攻击将危及彼此的和平与安全以及太平洋地区的安全，并宣布将根据其国内程序采取行动应对共同危险。” 澳大利亚将在未来十年内提供超过 10 亿美元的资金支持这一伙伴关系，旨在预防跨国犯罪，并投资于斐济的教育、医疗保健和基础设施项目。 澳大利亚与所有 14 个太平洋岛国都有不同程度的合作，并与巴布亚新几内亚、斐济、所罗门群岛、瓦努阿图、图瓦卢和瑙鲁签署了重大安全协议。 它还与该地区其他国家合作，从对外援助和基础设施资金到海洋监视和维和。 亨利·伊瓦拉图（Henry Ivarature）是澳大利亚太平洋安全学院的太平洋研究员。
